item.title: Containment and monitoring failures are to blame for AI hacking reports: experts
item.description: Cyber experts say AI labs’ containment and monitoring failures — not agents with minds of their own — are to blame for recent alarming hacking reports. CISOs should vet their AI vendors and tighten security basics as safeguards. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Optimizing Software Workflow: Exploring Fundamental Impacts in Technology
item.description: Software only has value when shipped; faster release cadence matters. Development, deployment, and operations require different thinking, metrics, and investments. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Grafana Tempo 3.1 Adds Query-Based Trace Redaction and Sampling-Aware TraceQL Metrics
item.description: Grafana Labs has released Tempo 3.1, the first minor update to the 3.0 architecture. (1 source: infoq)
